Jaap: Dutchman, and who knows what they get up to over there. The last I heard he was about to jump off a cliff wearing a bird-suit.
Jace: Finally, some parents who were progressive in a reasonable and intelligent manner! Jace is a tremendous, normal, funny kind of fellow. He'll help others from positions of power (ie - when he can), he has a large circle of friends and he looks forward to being a dad.
Jacek: The name given to that tiny drop of blood that appears after accidentally stabbing yourself with a pin. (ie. he tries to be neat, but he forgets to think sometimes, that’s all.)
Jack: As one of life’s great experiences, Jack is the name given to the phenomenon of a parcel arriving unexpectedly in the mail from a good friend. Outstanding. (Note: Jack is another Child Nightmare.)
Jackie: Funny guy. Loud mouth. Loves the spotlight. Not stupid.
Jackson: No, Jackson isn't bland, although there was that rumour floating around for a while. Jackson is actually far more attentive than you'd imagine. Sure, he's lazy, he never cleans his room and when he does have a job he's usually late to show up, but he has an easy smile which is genuine and when you get him one-on-one he's a pretty good listener.
Jaco: Look at him will ya? Standin' there on the corner, waitin' for the girls to come-a-runnin'.......his hair all trussed up, his thumbs in his pockets. Maybe he was born 40 years too late. Come on, come out here Jaco. I want you stand up in front of the class and tell us what you think. Trust me, you can't get it wrong, just be sure to stand tall and look us in the eye when you speak. Okay, you cool?...Excellent. Please begin...
Jacob:
Option A:  Jacob has a clean heart with a good soul. Sure, he might be a Baptist minister that hails from Vancouver and, yes, Canada is Boring’s idea of heaven but Jacob is worth his due. He has a toothy, natural grin and he possesses a generous laugh because he’s a generous man. Thank you Jacob.

Option B:  An out-of-control nut job, who needs to be shot at with the same device that takes care of Ross when he’s coming at you.
Jacobson: His name is like a maze. So, have you got him on a good day or he a bit melancholy and diffident? His name is almost too mature and wise for him to be an idiot, which is a pity. Yes, we all have responsibilities J, but once in a while you just have to say, "Bugger this. I quit." At which point you're entitled to stand up, throw your pen down, rip off your tie and get the hell out onto the open road and for some frivolous adventure! It'll do you good.
Jacobus: Jesus Jacobus, your name starts and stops and scoots off again like an old truck in need of a good overhaul. So, the formula? Stop once in a while and get away from the noise (idiots) you’re surrounded by and quiet the mind. Certainly, don’t get sucked into the moronic ideals in your midst. Learn to be comfortable in your own company and don’t do (too many) drugs…not in your case.
Jacques: An opinionated and arrogant Frenchman....well......not all of them of course. The team in the commentary box were just eager to see what reaction they got.
Jaddan: Jaddan, do you have nickname? Anyway, we suggest you eat all your vegetables, don't always do or say what your friends think and get out of the house more than you are. Amen.
Jade: Pretty Boy…actually, that’s not strictly correct. He’s just a city lad with silly parents, who were desperately trying to be cool after he was born.
Jaden: Stop dragging your feet, lad! Come on! Stand up. Do some good! Make a difference, I say!
Jae: The skinny rat bag who gets bored at the drop of a hat, and which is the only he gets into trouble like he does.
Jagger: Jagger will drift anywhere that the tide takes him. Jagger, my friend, get swimming and come here to shore. I'll feed you when you get here and then we'll form a game plan, okay? Start today.
Jago: The wonderful International Man of Intrigue and Spiritual Enlightenment. He began life as a baby chimpanzee carved out of ice-cream but then he grew up, and his name and character took off like a hang-glider taking flight from the edge of a windswept cliff. Who knows where he’s headed but it will be somewhere ethereal. No question.
Jai: Nah, Jai isn’t a show-off. He’s actually attached to the Earth far more than you imagine and he’s disappointed in the behaviour of most of the world’s multi-nationals.
Jaiden:
If Jaiden is American he one day hopes to fly to Mexico with some friends so they can drink and party on the beach.
If Jaiden is English he one day hopes to fly to Spain with some friends so they can drink and party on the beach.
If Jaiden is Australian he one day hopes to fly to Bali with some friends so they can drink and party on the beach.
If Jaiden is from Hong Kong he one day hopes to fly to Thailand with some friends so they can drink and party on the beach. Etc etc...
(Note: Jaiden ends up in a foreign hospital with hepatitis B and alchoholic poisoning.)
Jaimes: What a pretty little flower, he is! We can only presume he is aspires to become highly educated.
Jaivus:
Usually he's armed. Management has a suggestion for you, lad. Have you wondered what life would be like living somewhere where you don't need to carry a weapon? What you should be lugging around is a notebook, not a German made Gloc.
(Note: If he plays an instrument disregard the entire description.)
Jake: Jake has more pornography in his bedroom than any other male. He was once caught masturbating by his mother who burst into his room to find him standing over an upturned TV with his trousers around his ankles, and with Jake the Snake in his hand. He didn’t return to the house for days and, yes, he did eventually move out. He now wears a flannel shirt.
Jakob: Jakob might be an atheist, which is allowed, although we do hope that from time to time he ponders how he came to be living, and what this whole life-caper is about. Unfortunately he seems to be more interested in his own hairdo, which, let's face it, is a bloody mess. Is that the current trend?
Jamaal: Useless on a building site where he is expected to work hard for a long time.
Jamahl: Well goodness me, Jamahl, you got a job! Shit eh?! We knew you’d come good brother, we just knew it! Now you just have to pay back all that money to your parents. Don’t worry, you’ll get there.
Jamal: Jamal is decent fellow and socially adept. What he is skilled at, however, is grasping an opportunity when it arises and slipping through the gaps. Never forget that Jamal is a sneaky little fucker, and it helps that the boy can act.
Jameel: Jameel moves and walks like his joints are made of rubber. Fast with a grin and an escape plan, Jameel is quite serious about not being too serious. And if someone accuses him of being a girl or weak, he'll huff and puff like a souped-up male gorilla who would rather stomp the ground heavily rather than actually go into battle.
James: A master of disguise and one of the Enigmas. Fiendishly clever, the only thing he won’t do is dig holes, although he does loathe all forms of menial labour. Occasionally very serious, rarely flippant and often the funniest person in a room, he always keeps a little in reserve. This is the James’ way.
Jamie: Jamie is a young soul and often highly energetic or controversial. (Note: If he smokes a lot of cigarettes then the windows in his house will shake with the volume of his stereo.)
Jamil: Jamil, don't slouch! And we dont mind the fact that you appear to do nothing, but seriously dude, a little hard work is good for the soul.
Jamin: Jamin spends more time than most looking inward, not outward. As a very bright and occasionally quite intense young man, it’ll do him good to get outside amongst it and  to look up once in a while, if for no other reason that to see how large and amazing this world is. Don't worry about all that career crap Jamin - that'll come in good time if it needs to.
Jan: (Pron. Yarn) Jan lives a streamlined life and rarely is he overweight. His European heritage assists him to be quite direct and so he accomplishes tasks with relative ease, yet he is a relaxed character who is comfortable in all social situations.
Jane: Yep, you heard right. And don't worry, we're scratching our heads up here in the commentary box too. But, hello, it seems Jane can actually play a bit! Oh, I see. He's under the radar, isn't he? By the time you stop and consider who you are dealing with he's got the ball and he's off, laughing hard all the way. Nice job Jane. Nice job indeed. (And no, he ain't no brick layer.)
Jannes: He's the clean-living fellow with the whistle in his mouth, ready to blow it if he sees an infringement, or some kind of impending danger up ahead. Rarely outspoken and lewd, Jannes works hard and plays well, ensuring that no one is either left out or emotionally damaged by the events at hand. Conscientious and wise, Jannes is a man to be trusted and relied upon and rarely (if ever) would you find him in a rehab clinic…well…unless he was working there, of course.
JanNiklas: Like Andre way before him, Jan Niklas looks nothing like the organised man you might expect. He smiles easily and he's nowhere near as anal as he sounds
Janos: Janos walks around in circles because his right foot is bigger than his left. It does make him a patient man, however, with a bright opinion of everything.
Jared: Jared is basically identical to Jarred except that he’s slightly more gullible
Jari: Jari isn’t as irresponsible as you think. If he’s a boy you should probably sell him, but as a young man he dots his i’s and crosses his t’s. There is every chance that at some point in his life he’ll find himself at a forest doof, where he’ll probably take some acid or some such thing, close his eyes and just dance for days while being attached to the universe in ways which will be indecipherable to most old folk.
Jaron:
"Hang on, is that Darren, Sharon or who, did you say?"
This is the miniature, instantaneous and internal debate everyone has inside their head the first time they meet Jaron. And what does all this mean? Well, Jaron is polite for a start, but rarely is he able to produce a wild, loud and in-your-face response which stems from a solid basis of being ‘known’.
In adulthood therefore Jaron is a wildcard and, perhaps more than most, he is on a journey of self-discovery that this ‘unknowingness’ provides.
Jarrah: Does anyone know where he went? We saw him leg it over the fence but that was hours ago? Has he shown up at the police station?......No?......Okay, well, we'll just wait around here then. He knows where his bread is buttered.
Jarred: Jarred is a polite, normal and content young man with a clean soul and a rural background (unless he gets drunk with a group of his male friends, in which case he’s liable to fall into the macho pack-mentality of group idiocy). Did he ever grow out of that??
Jarrett: Jarrett deals with the hectic city life better than most. Sure, he'd prefer to live by the sea in a more calmer and cleaner setting but for the time being he deals with the big smoke very well. Stress doesn't really absorb into his skin and so the usual dramas that bother people don’t normally effect him. He has an easy smile, he's patient enough and he gravitates friends to him. He’s another who would make a good dad and he’s looking forward to the day when it happens.
Jarrin: Good at pool. Although his hair gets in the way most of the time.
Jarrod: A simple man, Jarrod has dreams of sitting in a tub full of warm mash potato that's had a full bucket of butter dropped into it. But he's not selfish at all. He'll share it with you.
Jarvis: Record producer. He spends most of his time in L.A these days but he's a hard man to pin down. He doesn't mind London but the weather gets to him. On Sunday afternoons, back at his place, you'll often see him hanging by the pool with the 'crew', half of which seem to be gorgeous skinny girls in bikinis. He's best mates with Elvis and their parties, consequently, are even more famous than they are. Jarvis.
Jase: Polite, friendly and open, Jase attracts friends and business. He doesn't possess a nasty/vengeful bone in his body - unless someone has done something truly heinous - and life seems to be kind to him. He's make an excellent vet because he hates seeing animals in any kind of pain.
Jasen: More thoughtful than his cast of ‘Jason cousins’ he gets into less trouble and is more sensitive in general. Timid once upon a time, Jasen succeeds through hard work and diligence.
Jason:
Jason is one of the few creatures in the Kingdom to have two completely distinct subspecies: 
Jasonicus thuggus: Before he became a son of jail, he was a violent criminal who was sucked down one of life's tougher paths, in lieu of the fact that he carries one of the truly mean and irrational tempers. 
Jasonicus raucous: A highly intelligent, very active and super playful creature who doesn't have a nasty bone in his body, although all Jasons are competitive mongrels when they want to be. 
The latter is a splendid specimen while the former needs to learn how to forgive.
Jasper: Born to get around corners easily, Jasper is slippery like an eel in both body and acumen, although he arrives with a splendid sense of decorum. Keep an eye out though because if there’s an angle yet to be tested then you just wait, he’ll find it.
Javier: Tall, dark and handsome, or possibly short, dark and nuggety, Javier swans along as if it’s all too easy. And perhaps it is. It’s all about attitude of course, as it is for each of us.
Jax: Not the most indefatigable of characters, Jax is fair weather sailor. He doesn’t want to take the yacht out in mountainous seas. No way. Plus, out there in the middle of the night, drenched, sea-sick and shitting himself, basically, and not that we blame him, how would he ever look cool? No one would see him for a start.
Jaxon: Fluff, until he stands tall in his own energy. (Another youngster who is a disaster in the classroom.)
Jaxson: A fully-fledged nightmare as a child, did he grow out of that? Anyone? Not quite blue chip stock, more like blue collar, and that’s okay.
Jay: Jay is an unusual bloke with an addictive nature and he’s so complex that he’s nearly simple. He thinks a lot – perhaps too much – but his interest in the various peoples of the world knows no bounds.
Jayce: Ah, a slippery customer who knows the market very well, so well in fact he’d make a splendid inside trader.
Jayden: Relaxed. Intelligent. Complex. Jayden is a funny guy without being the life of the gathering and he’s quirky without being a bore. Yep, Jayden does quite nicely most of the time. But hang on….what’s missing here?…
Jayke: Far more patient and socially aware than his masturbating cousin (Jake), Jayke has to spell his name every 30 minutes, and far from producing an impatient, disturbed individual, it has given him a sense of calmness which many admire and certainly most should aspire to. Did he ever attend university? Who cares. He's a nice fellow with good friends. He's a good judge of character who doesn't tolerate charlatans of any kind and while behind closed doors he never dies wondering, he is nothing if not polite. Nice one Jayke.
Jaymz: Do what you like of course Jaymz, but get out of the city for a while. Just for a change of pace and for a setting devoid of glass, concrete or mirrors.
Jazber: Jazber is irrefutable and irresistable, like one of those old motorbikes with a massive two-stroke engine. He takes a while to get started and he'd sleep all day if you let him, but when he fixes his gaze on what he wants and he gets up to speed, then look out!
Jazz: On the surface Jazz is a happy, engaging sort of guy. But, under all that good will, and there's usually plenty, is a competitive streak that you only really experience properly if you're in the ring with him. Yes, Jazz is a cage-fighter, and he can look after himself.
JD: (Said with a deep, slow voice)..... “My name’s JD... and I like my women... dim and pretty.”
Jean: True, it is impossible to take a man too seriously when his name is Jean, and so he had nowhere to go other than down the path of either the nonchalant comic legend, or the unforgiving captain of industry who is famous for getting heavily drunk and wanting to brawl.
Jean-Claude: Is he French? Oui? Okay, well, JC approaches life like a skilled exponent of origami. He likes to look at things, take a step back, and then deliberately turn them around so he can observe from a totally different angle. He's quite a quirky individual.
Jean-Pierre: JP strolls around as if a nearby orchestra is playing the waltz. He smiles at most people and most things, usually, and while his financial life is often a disaster, you'd never know it.
Jeandry: Did you ever hear of or see an American basketballer called Kareem Abdul Jabaar? (If in doubt, I suggest you rent the movie Airport, where he plays a wonderful cameo.) Anyway, Kareem moves in the same way as Jeandry's entire personality. He's a goofball, takes little seriously, and kind of floats (or plods) along like he hasn't planned a thing, even though he seems to always be in the right place at the right time. Know what I mean?
Jed: Jed has a resting pulse of 11, he is able to carry a grown cow under each arm and he has a laugh with nearly everybody. Jed, how are you boy?
Jeda: A reserved young man who does better as a lone competitor than in a team of macho wankers. He knows his talents, his limits and his potential, and being surrounded by a pack of grunting, testosterone-filled buffoons is enough to turn him off team sports forever. Perhaps he should try his hand at furniture making? He has patience and a good eye....so who knows?
Jedi: Yep, and I'm Elmer Fudd, how are ya?
Jeff: An agreeable, amiable and hard-working man, Jeff is often covered in concrete dust. Which is to say, he'll do the job and see it through, and he's rarely surprised by what it took.
Jelly: Sure, Jelly is one fluid individual but he’s not fat and he’s not stupid. What Jelly is a genius at, and what many many people seem to struggle with, is a thing called ‘change’. It’s never scared him – why would it? – indeed, he thrives on it.
Jenon: Vacuum cleaner. (He makes a lot of noise, he looks good in the cupboard, and he likes shiny red outfits.)
Jens: The name of the fellow who comes around to your house to fix your printer. He's a quiet kind of guy and a nice one.
Jensen: The army Corporal who aspires to be a General. On the surface he is a tremendous leader of men but, sadly, he lacks common sense and this makes him incredibly dangerous in a situation where he’s in charge of men with guns.
Jeremi: Art teacher. The kind of man that his students come to appreciate more and more, the longer they spend out of school. As a chilled out, long-haired pseudo-hippie they all came to realise it wasn't the skills of art he was trying to instil, although he did do a good job of that, but more a sense of trying to look at the various things in the world from as many points of view as possible. Most of all, they remember laughing with him lots.
Jeremiah: Jeremiah is a decent person and an aggressive haggler, such that rarely does he walk out of a shop without a discount. If the situation is reversed his rather suave and sanguine sales approach means the patrons rarely know that they're being given the hard sell. More than one woman has slapped him, too.
Jeremy: Jeremy is intelligent and ostensibly gentle, but if he’s highly ambitious then he can be a slippery customer to deal with. He’d make an excellent head steward for an airline.
Jergen:
Prompt. 
Clean. 
Educated.
Diligent. 
A little pig-headed but a nice smile. 
Funny in a twisted, European kind of way. 
Usually blonde. 
Jergen.
Jerome: Rarely visibly excited, Jerome speaks fluent French, Arabic and English and he used to work for the military.
Jerremy: I know what you're thinking Jerremy - you want to do what Corrado did. Mate, I'm telling you, it looks like fun. It's not. If you want to rub your testicles against some leather, captain, visit an S&M club where someone who knows what they are doing can adminster the pain properly. You got that?
Jerry: The name of a cardboard box used to hold bananas. He’s sort of useful, kind of flexible and semi-interesting if you need to move anywhere, but if he sits in the corner for too long you’ll forget that he exists at all.
Jeshua: See Davo, and we wish you the best of luck.
Jess: A baby-faced teenager no matter how old he is, who has a surprising amount of initiative.
Jesse: Jesse rhymes with Mud Brick. (i.e: get him outside, get him away from technology.)
Jesus: People stop and take a second when they hear his name, and Jesus is mild mannered as a result – possibly even timid.
Jethro: What a unit? Jethro is the only man in the Kingdom who, if walking down the street on his own, will whisper quietly to his penis about what's happening so it/he/his buddy doesn't miss out. Jethro.
Jett: Jett can only count up to twenty nine. Is he an astrologer?
Jevan: Agile and healthy, Jevan is a friendly man who rarely gets into major disputes. We're not sure but we suspect it's because he likes to be on the move, which means anyone who has a gripe with him can't usually find him. However, he has friends and he's a social animal. Does he have the capacity to be led down the garden path by someone else's misplaced enthusiasm?....Yep.
Jez: He’s no Rhodes Scholar but he’s 100% true blue.
Jezzrah: The beers up are up, lad, but please tell me there's more to your life than this…..?
Ji: No quiet moments. Not much sleep. A well-travelled background and a penchant for dangerous and out-of-control spouses means Ji, almost by default, has an artistic edge which always needs an outlet.
JieLi: Cambodian or not, Jie Li has learnt how easily a smile gets things done, and how it makes people suddenly more eager to help.
Jim:
Option A:  Brainwashed by society to the conformities of what constitutes a strong male in a rural environment, Jim, while a pleasant and generous individual, is incapable of dealing with highly complex issues. He is a simple fellow at his core, so maybe he’s lucky that he lives a simple life.

Option B:  Good bloke.
Jimbo: Jimbo is a sensational, goofy and loving man, who would be able to accomplish so much more in life if not for the fact that he has a sheep brain in his cranium, and not a human one.
Jimma: The intellectual and/or physical juggernaut that, like many-a-James, keeps a fair bit in reserve while quietly biding his time.
Jimmy: Like any decent crap that you’re dying to have, Jimmy is bare-boned, rude, proud, occasionally very funny and, generally, wonderful to experience. (Just be careful of the cleanup.)
Jisou: Jisou is an under-the-radar operator. He has the dedication and passion to enable him to stare at a screen/sculpture/mould/garden/duco for hours or days until he is sure he’s got it just right.
JJ: Known and loved by hundreds, JJ is exceptionally bright and enthusiastic. One of his few failings is that he is incapable of saying the word ‘no’. Whenever he goes out at night, he wears bright silver pants that could have been worn by any famous motorcycle stunt rider. Women adore him until he falls foul of them, at which point they learn to treat him like a lovable little brother. Hate never gets a look-in.
Jo: If Jo is from the country there is a good chance he could skin a sheep or a goat before he could walk. And if Jo is from the city he works for the financial system and has no idea about skinning or killing anything.
Joakim: Active and tidy, Joakim is an energetic individual whose appreciation of people and place provides a refreshing point of view.
Jobe: Is he a Rhodes Scholar? Well, probably not, but as one of the most genial men in the Kingdom he never has a bad word for anyone.
Joby: Wet sock. But, if someone tells him to put them on and run to the top of that mountain in the pouring rain, he knows they'll be wet soon anyway, even if they were dry. The moral to the story: do your best, and the best will happen young man.
Jock: He might be Scottish and he might not, but Jock is very intelligent, surprisingly sensitive and extremely funny. So long as he doesn’t live near any kind of outback mining community, then Jock is a wonderful bloke.
Jocko: Had he decided to become a comedian or an actor he’d be famous by now, and for all the right reason.
Jody:
A 1960's cartoon detective. He wears a hat popular with gangsters, he never leaves the house without a black tie and his shoes are always polished. But he's a canny sleuth. Good old fashion clues - this is what he likes. None of this modern-day DNA bullshit. And he dislikes what mobile phones are doing to the population.

"If you say you're going to be somewhere,” Jody often says, “then damn-well be there. The End." As a chivalrous man Jody opens car doors for ladies.
Joe: Joe moves, thinks and speaks slowly, unless he has an Asian heritage, in which case he does exactly the opposite.
Joel: Joel has one of the lowest IQ’s in the entire Kingdom. (The fact of the matter is that he's too busy crashing his bike, surfing, setting stuff on fire or fishing. He never even heard about the bloody I.Q test and so never attended. Thus, when the scores came back he was at the bottom. Joel.)
Joey: In what is considered a miracle of human physiology, while his body kept ageing, his brain and intellect ceased developing at the age of 14. To this day no one is sure if this is a curse or a blessing...
Joff: If Joff turns up with a carton of beer he rarely takes the time to stick them in a fridge or an esky. He just rips into the cardboard, hands out the beers to whoever wants one and away he goes, cracking beer number one. Days such as these rarely end quickly and never quietly.
Johan: Another fellow with a European bent. On a bad day he’s only a little temperamental and possibly a tad impatient, but that’s about as bad as it gets. He certainly doesn’t hide his feelings and for a technically-minded soul he has a deep, infectious laugh.
Johannes: His teutonic nature borders on dull stolidity but he may surprise you with a joyful eruption of laughter that leaves you happy, and wondering if you're right. Is he South African? Yes, well, like Ross, get out your gun and keep it locked on him in case he makes a run at you...
John: John is the name of that huge boulder sitting out there on its own, near the edge of town. He’s been there so long that we hardly even notice him any more – he’s just part of the furniture. There’s a section on the other side of him that hardly ever sees the sun, which may have occasional ramifications, although nothing’s perfect anyway, but there he sits. He’ll be there long after all these humans are dust and one day he will become dust himself.
John-John: In reality we’re not sure why there exists differences between man-made wonders of the world and those which are described as natural - I mean, both exist here on Earth, so why does it matter? - yet here we are. Two very heavy, conservative names placed together produce a diamond the likes of which many never be repeated again. We’ve no explanation. He might as well be an alien, so skilled and unique is he. (Very lazy when it comes to chasing the ladies, however, so I suppose no one is perfect.)
John-Louis: JL is the only man on Earth who cannot make love to anyone unless there is a functioning sextant in the room. Perhaps he was an explorer in a past life, I'm not sure, but he definitely has a flair for the dramatic.
John-Ryan: A tough youngster gives rise to a man who doesn’t grin as much as he could, or probably should. Peace, love and serenity are things to be aspired to chief, and it’s okay to show your vulnerabilities these days. Promise.
JohnFrancis: Leadership can be tough, both for your friends and sometimes your family, but somebody has to keep an eye out for fires on the horizon. Prevention is always better than the cure – you’ll hear him say these words more than once. He doesn’t mind if you dislike his style and he doesn’t care if you talk about him behind his back. That’s not his business. His job is to keep everyone alive and as happy as is possible, and if he succeeds at that the rest is just fluff. Amen.
Johnno: The Mr. Good Natured who no one despises. Unfortunately (or fortunately) Johnno suffers from the same disease as Dave and Bob in that every stranger who ever meets him feels like they already know him.
Johnny: When he was young, Johnny went so hard that he nearly went crazy but he finished all of that a long time ago and he has mellowed dramatically. Nowadays, his soul has relaxed completely and his confidence and quiet charisma leads the way. Johnny is admired by many, and the funny thing is that these admirers aren't even aware of it. Weird eh?
Jolie: Jolie has a surprising amount of pluck and, no, levity is not necessarily his middle name. He likes things done his way and he believes in his own actions.
Jolin: Jolin is like a small hound who behaves when the humans are around, but then as soon as they are gone is prone to tearing apart lounge rooms or wailing for hours in the hope of gleaning some attention from anywhere. He is perpetually on the brink of losing his driver’s licence.
Jolon: Jolon works with his hands or possibly in the lower echelons of a white collar company. His saviours are his friends and this thing we call alcohol. Is it a curse? Perhaps…
Jon: The gay/artistic/feminine/sensitive/more progressive version of John.
Jonah: The name topples over itself at the finish like a huge ocean wave crashing over a reef after a journey of a thousand miles and, therefore, there is a sense of tragic magnificence about him. But ignore all that. Jonah is no fool, far from it, and he is one of the few men who, if he taps into his potential, could influence the lives of many many people. If you meet him you should ask him if you can help. (Note: if he’s shy or a little timid, get hold of a whip and get him out that door. Amen.)
Jonas: Jonas, it's great that you take a keen interest in your own health - in a perfect world we all probably should - but what's this fascination with your own rectum? It's got a few of us up here concerned…
Jonathan: To say he is self-righteous and proud might possibly infer he is something of an arrogant twat. He’s not – indeed, Jonathan has a great sense of humour. But it’s true, he’s self-righteous and proud, and there endeth the lesson.
Jonathon: If he isn’t either slightly ridiculous or an eccentric tosser, and there’s a 47% chance he is, then Jonathon is quiet and demure, and if you were to walk into a lounge room where he was nestled comfortably into a couch and he didn’t move or greet you, you’d barely register his presence. (Which is why he’s accidentally seen couples having sex in front of him at least a dozen times.)
Jonesy: Jonesy takes most calamities in his stride, not that he sees too many. As a prankster who is a magnet for friends and strangers, he uplifts all those in his midst. Usually he’s completely reliable and he’ll bend over backwards for just about anyone - fuckwits excluded.
Jonte: United Nations rep? Bullshit. Jonte is a pair of clean coloured socks.
Jordan: Too cool for school. (Again, what is it with these American names? And if he is one then please ignore the question.) Anyway, Jordan has a good heart, he just needs a bit of direction, that's all. In that regard he's not on his own.
Jorden: The shy cat who, usually, is well aware of his own skills and limitations. The only downside of this is that he rarely talks himself up and sometimes, in this crazy modern world, you have to.
Jordie: Yep, he's an exact mix of the man above and man below….beyond that my lips are sealed. Management.
Jordy: Lucky he’s skilled cos’ he’s crazy. The ladies love him.
Joseph: A serious character who is there when you need him. He frowns more than he smiles but it’s probably all a front. He’s a good person and far brighter than you’d imagine.
Josh: Unexpectedly hilarious, secretly competitive and sometimes understated, Josh has the capacity to outmanoeuvre almost any opponent. It’s not that he’s the brightest spark in the pack, he’s not, though he’s no village idiot either, but he combines a nice mix of persistence, guile and humour. (Note: If he’s under 10 years of age he is a bloody nightmare.)
Joshua: The sensitive arts student who has many more female friends than male. He desperately wants to win the the national portrait prize.
Josiah: Josiah has a kind heart, we think, although usually he requires something like a Babel Fish (please refer to The Hitchhikers Guide to the Galaxy - it’s a book, Josiah) to understand even reasonably basic interpretations of just about everything. But forget all that. Hand him a soccer ball and tell him to go outside - that solves most problems later on.
Joss: We're scratching our heads up here in commentary box, trying to remember if anyone has ever seen Joss with anything other than a giant smile on his face. Anyone?...No? Oh well, there you have it. Joss is officially in the Top 20 happiest people in the Kingdom. But that doesn't make him a push-over. I wouldn't assume that.
Jove: Lets’s hope he doesn’t have a religious family for if that’s the case, if they can’t find him he’ll probably be in rehab, again. If not…..actually, do you know what?….let’s just find out if his dad is a rabbi then take it from there. Good luck.
Judd: Judd spends hours trying to make his hair look as if he's just woken up after having slept on the beach, and having surfed all day before that. Question: Judd, do you surf and do you sleep on the beach? No? Well come on, let's get serious. You're a nice fellow so ditch all this hair-crap and figure out what it is that's really important to you. THAT'S the key!
Jude: Jude is a mellow and sufficiently suave individual but he wouldn’t be seen dead drinking at the pub that his identical sister (Jude) works at, which is a pity. Having said that, if he did, and he got into a fight, she’d be able to defend him better than he would.
Juice: A sinewy little fucker who gets pissed and takes his pants off.
Juilian: No, Juilian has never made a batch of concrete in his life but that's not his gig. He's into numbers and the stats, he likes his shoes to be shiny and he is very adept at tying his tie quickly. Number of hair product items in his bathroom: 12.
Juke: Maybe his dad wanted him to be the playboy that he never was, who knows? Juke is a working man of simple needs, and who usually walks in the door a filthy mess. Big smile. Foul temper.
Jules: Friendly. Confident. Playful. Relaxed. Blah blah blah...but he’s weird when he’s pissed because he can’t handle his alcohol.
Julian: Julian plays an instrument and he’s okay without setting the world on fire. What he is skilled at, however, is placating angry people and thinking with a political mind.
Julius: (First onto the life raft.) Like a thoroughbred horse that's almost impossible for the jockey to keep under control, Julius's ego threatens to tear off and take over. But do you know, young Julius isn't that naïve. We do hope he's called Jules occasionally, just to keep him grounded, otherwise he'll be poured into the clichéd path of designer sunnies and $400 jeans. Neither are any good for the planet, but it seems Julius turns out to be more thoughtful than that. Sure, there's a 70% that his wife might be described as a trophy, but he deals with business thinking and underlings in an astute manner. Someone has to run the company.
Jumbuck: The alcoholic stoner who is as irrepressible as he is funny. (And, yes, he shears sheep.)
Jurek: No energy to waste here. None. So don’t waste his time with half-measures and a lazy intent. Even his sense of humour is dry, at best. It might be the Polish blood in him, who knows, but his ancestors grew up in freezing winters and they therefore learned not to fuck about, and this genetic memory runs through Jurek big time.
Jurgen: Blonde. Does he have Northern European heritage? Probably. It makes him honest and direct, and he takes his time when he believes success is inevitable.
Jusstin:
Jusstin, Management took an oath never to say this to anyone – after all, we each have a niche to fill and who is to say one name is any better than another - but in your case we are going to make an exception. Why the double S? Like one S isn't dodgy enough. But, on the flip side, we see that you are actually quite a chilled-out man who takes life's hits on the chin and who moves on quickly. Indeed, fuck it, don’t listen to us. Keep doing what you’re doing and let us know how you go.
Yours sincerely
Management.
Justin: ‘Justin’ is what happens to a bowl of cereal if you leave it to take an extended phone call. Soggy, dull and aesthetically horrific, afterwards, to finish the meal is tantamount to culinary suicide.
Juzo: I know, you've got one less Z than your mate, just below you. Juzo, but fear not. Head on down to Juzzo and he'll show what's going on. Oh, and by the way, welcome to the LIGHT!
Juzzo:
Thank God! A Justin has made it out of the swamp and landed in a hammock, next to which is a table holding a bottle of beer, wine or sparkling mineral water (whatever takes your fancy, really), it's in the shade, it's near the beach, and woah, hang on! There's someone in the hammock with you! Well excuse me! I'll leave you in peace Juzzo. Take it easy and well done.  
Love Management.
Jye: Jye, my friend, it's not possible for someone to know everything unless you are some kind of God. So, are you? (Actually, don’t answer that.)
